sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Entry point and build commands
sections.what: Declares the source file as the entry point and sets build, clean, lint and typecheck commands.
sections.why: Lets other packages import the types by name.
sections.watch_out: The entry points to source, so the types only work where TypeScript is handled.

summary: Package file for the shared type definitions that the API and apps use to agree on data shapes.
purpose: Provides the contract types as a package that other apps can import.
why: Likely reason: one shared source keeps all apps consistent.
how: Points the entry at the TypeScript source file. The build script bundles it with tsup into CommonJS and ES module formats. Lint and typecheck run on the source folder.
outputs: A bundled output folder when built, and type check results.
risks: Consumers may import the raw TypeScript source, so they need a TypeScript-aware toolchain. The shared tsconfig package is listed as a dependency but the tsconfig file does not use it.
debug: If another app cannot find the types, check the entry paths and run the build. Run typecheck to confirm the source compiles.
